sloka: अधोभागे न मे दृष्टिः शोचता पातिता मया ।ततो ऽद्राक्षमहं भीमां राक्षसीं सलिलेशयाम् ।। ५.५८.३७ ।।।।
transliteration: adhobhāge na me dṛṣṭiḥ śocatā pātitā mayā ।tato 'drākṣamahaṁ bhīmāṁ rākṣasīṁ salileśayām ।। 5.58.37 ।।।।

translations.english: "Thinking so I looked down into the water and there I saw a terrific shedemon.
